title: Melodia master material spine canon
purpose: Locks the six production master materials, their group canon, layout doctrine, runtime integration map, and archive policy so agents do not reinvent them. Engine-level truth is always re-derived from the live assets via Tools/masters_spine_census.py; this spec never overrides the assets.

spine.notes: Gaea-driven layer system (Ground/Grass/Rock base + Snow/Water/Mud/Path extended), Rock triplanar detail, Snow SDF distance band, Nikki families 07-18, Landscape Cymatics. Live use: MI_Poitou_Landscape_Nikki on the Poitou landscape.
Layered texture layout, parallax, TriplanarPro normal+ORM branches (2026-10-28), Nikki SDF iris, gouache wash, glitter, character extensions.

spine.role: big generalist toon master (A-Layer + Nikki + convergence columns)
spine.notes: Closeout-standard column canvas (X>=10000). Zero-comment enumeration anomaly documented 2026-10-28; treat layout via exported graph baseline.
Water integration authority; do not fork a second water master.

spine.role: SDF toon lane master (relief bands, gilding, ink, ornament)
spine.notes: This SDF subfolder copy is canon; any Masters/-root duplicate of an SDF master is not spine and must not be re-created.

rules: No parallel master: new looks are instances or new columns/parameters on a spine master. A demonstrated blocker against a spine master is the only path to a new master, with owner sign-off.
Parameter identity is ParameterName + ExpressionGUID; Group renames are MI-safe because instance overrides key on identity, never on group strings.
Layout batches are identity-preserving: no connections, no default values, no slot material changes, no parameter renames in the same batch as layout.
Every mutating batch requires: backup duplicate first, save only the touched package, pre/post get_compilation_stats parity, and a validate_material re-read whose new-issue delta is zero.
Texture placeholder defaults (gradient-pack/T_Neutral) are fallback-only: live MIs must override real PBR textures; never treat the placeholder as content.

Shared fan-out parameters (same name, multiple nodes, e.g. bGaeaWholeLandscapeColor x5) are deliberate; validate_material duplicate-name warnings for them are documented, not defects to fix by renaming.
Do not touch MF_MeshBlend_* or anything under Content/TurnBasedJRPGTemplate/Blueprints/Skills/ (fatal Python-glue landmine).
One Unreal editor, one mutating surface (Monolith / MaterialEditingLibrary). Never bulk save; save exact packages only.

layout_standard.headers: Every column carries a comment header titled 'NN | Family Name'. Legacy 'MELODIA_COLUMN:NN | ...' prefixes are retired by the batch pass (prefix stripped).
layout_standard.columns: Family number is unique per master and non-colliding: shared spine 01-18 where present, appends take fresh numbers >= 19 (fabric/landscape), >= 41 (Toon_Universal), or 01-08 (freshly numbered masters).
layout_standard.groups: Group names are the canonical identity for the MI editor: 'NN | Family'. Ungrouped parameters on a spine master are a defect: every parameter must belong to exactly one numbered family.
layout_standard.canvas: Comment shells must envelop their member cluster; per-master absolute grid alignment is optional and not required for canon.

polish_doctrine.case_study: Infinity Nikki (Infold/Papergames, UE5). Primary sources: Apple Developer feature 2026-04 ('re-engineered fabric algorithm ... four-layer UV blending textures ... minimal parameter adjustments ... diverse sparkle responses'); Unreal Engine developer interview 2024-08 ('versatile master material ... easy for artists to use'); Silicon Studio Enlighten GI 2025-02.
derived_rules: Master+instance doctrine: one versatile master per domain, parameter-driven variety (cotton/linen vs silk/satin = roughness/sheen parameter states, not new masters).
Layered texture blending with a small parameter surface per layer (our Texture Layer A/B/C and landscape layer lanes).
Custom reflections and sparkle response are first-class parameter families (Nikki Sparkle, Glitter Halo, Glitter Pile).
PBR clamps in the master: RoughnessMin/Max and MetallicScale live in 01 | Base Surface (present on Nikki masters).
World-aligned projection (TriplanarPro) is the default detail lane for terrain and fabric; per-MI surprises are not canon.
open_expansion_asks: Shared PBR-clamp + Toksvig MF (clamped roughness, specular discipline) consumable by all spine masters - schedule as graph-surgery batches with full parity, one master at a time.
Proving preset MIs for every column on Character / Water / Toon_Universal (landscape and SDF lanes already have preset families).
ORM packed input lane on the landscape master (Gaea currently exports masks, not ORM).

runtime_integration.cymatics: Beat/impact/reactivity enter materials as Material Parameter Collection readers (MelPile:MPC_*). Landscape: 25 | Landscape Cymatics. Universal: 90 | Cymatics + 41 | Audio React. Fabric: 24 | Audio & Cymatics. Character: 07 | Cymatics. SDF: 12 | Audio.
runtime_integration.chladni: Chladni presentation rides 08 | Chladni Fleece on M_Master_Toon_Character and ChladniMask/Color inside Universal 90 | Cymatics; per-actor MID reads OnResonanceChanged/GetResonanceNormalized (presentation reads, never writes gameplay).
runtime_integration.toon_banding: Toon-ramp family: bToonRampEnabled/ToonRampStrength/bToonRampActive -> fabric 23 | Toon Ramp, Universal 42 | Toon Ramp, SDF 13 | Toon Ramp; band structure stays in each master's 09 | Color Ramp / toon profile lanes.
runtime_integration.water: M_Water_Oceanology_Melodia owns single-layer-water; biolum/toon-band/sparkle columns are its canon families.

archive_policy.moves: Only zero-referencer assets move. Orphaned masters -> Masters/_Retired/<date>/; orphaned instances -> Instances/_Legacy/. Redirectors are never deleted casually; _Archive and _PROJECT legacy libraries are policy no-delete.
archive_policy.current_candidates: audit_orphan_materials 2026-10-28 page 1: MI_Water_Underwater_Post_Default (v9-era), MI_Melusina_WaterHair, four Couture_20261026 MIs (another lane's 2026-10-26 batch - do not move without that lane's sign-off). Full list in Saved/Audit/MastersSpine_20261028/.
archive_policy.backups: Pre-polish backups live in Masters/_Backup/ as <Name>_PreSpinePolish_20261028 and are local-only evidence; they are re-verifiable by census re-run.
